stand: Drones have struck Black Sea shipping twice in two days: a Turkish-flagged grain carrier sank near Romania on 5 October, killing two, and Bulgaria's Alfa Watan and Able were hit on 6 October, sinking one and damaging the other roughly 80 miles off the coast. Bulgarian PM Rumen Radev calls it a violation of international law but will not name the attacker; Ukraine's Zelensky blames Russian drones for the Romania strike. Bulgarian opposition accuses Radev of shielding Moscow. Estonia received 13 US reconnaissance drones for border security.

claims.text: A drone strike sank the Turkish-flagged grain carrier Royad Mammadov near Romania, killing two and leaving 11 rescued.
claims.by: Says: Romania's Ministry of Internal Affairs

claims.text: The Romania grain-carrier strike was carried out by two Russian drones.
claims.by: Says: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy; Denies: not addressed by Russia in these articles

claims.text: Drones struck two commercial vessels, the Alfa Watan and the Able, in Bulgaria's Black Sea exclusive economic zone.
The origin of the drones in the Bulgaria attack is unresolved; Radev will not name an aggressor while opposition figures say it is clearly Russia.
claims.by: Says: PM Rumen Radev ("either Russian or Ukrainian"); Denies/alleges: opposition figures Assen Vassilev and Ivaylo Mirchev say it is Russia and accuse Radev of shielding it

claims.text: A surviving crew member says the Alfa Watan was hit by a naval mine from underneath, not a drone.
claims.by: Says: unnamed Turkish crew member; Denies: no government confirmation of cause given in these articles

claims.text: NATO's top commander has urged member states to publicly name those they believe responsible for drone incidents once evidence is gathered.
claims.by: Says: NATO Supreme Allied Commander Gen. Alex Grynkewich

claims.text: Germany took almost a month to publicly blame Russia for an August drone-and-explosives attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport.
The US transferred 13 Skydio X10D reconnaissance drones to Estonia's Police and Border Guard Board.
claims.by: Says: US Embassy in Estonia / Ambassador Roman Pipko

claims.text: Zelensky says more than 12 anti-drone turrets have been installed in Kyiv, protecting against Shahed drones.
Zelensky discussed strengthening defences against Russian Shahed drones with Dutch PM Rob Jetten.

timeline.text: A drone laden with explosives attempted an attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport in Germany.
The US and Estonia signed a transfer agreement for 13 Skydio X10D border-surveillance drones at Tallinn's Miinisadam Naval Base.
A drone strike sank the Turkish-flagged grain carrier Royad Mammadov near Romania's coast; two were killed and 11 rescued.
Zelensky discussed Shahed-drone air defences with Dutch PM Rob Jetten and cited new Kyiv anti-drone turrets.
Drones struck two commercial vessels in Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone around 3 a.m.; the Alfa Watan sank and the Able caught fire.
PM Rumen Radev called the strike a blatant violation of international law after an emergency government meeting, without naming an aggressor.
Acting President Iliana Iotova signed a decree to convene Bulgaria's security council on Wednesday (7 Oct).
Opposition figures accused Radev of avoiding naming Russia as the aggressor out of sympathy for the Kremlin.
Romania scrambled F-16 fighter jets to destroy a maritime drone near the Neptun Deep gas platform in the Black Sea.
NATO's Gen. Alex Grynkewich urged member states to publicly identify those responsible for drone incidents once evidence is gathered.
